title: Hitler orders arrest of occultists and astrologers after Hess's flight
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Hitler orders arrest of occultists and astrologers after Hess's flight, about 1941 at Nazi Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Hitler then ordered all occultists, all astrologers in Germany to be arrested, thrown in the camps, right?

plain: An author named Peter Levenda, who wrote a book called Unholy Alliance about the Nazis and the occult, says that in 1941, after Hitler's deputy Rudolf Hess flew to Britain on his own, Hitler ordered every occultist and astrologer in Germany to be arrested and sent to the camps. Levenda tells it to show how deeply occult ideas ran in the Nazi leadership, and how much Hitler feared them.
